coordinate_convention.rectangles: [left, top, right, bottom), pixels; x right, y down
coordinate_convention.landmarks: Manual visual estimates unless explicitly alpha-measured; hidden anatomy is not measured.
coordinate_convention.head_core: Cranial envelope excluding ears, sprout and robot side modules where separable; not an alpha crop.

canonical.ground_measurement: bottom edge of alpha bounds; contact approximation
canonical.notes: Preserved byte-for-byte; this remains the identity authority if generated views disagree.

layout.note: Use explicit cell rectangles; equal row heights are not guaranteed by generation.

turnaround.background: opaque neutral gray; reference-only, not a transparent animation frame

review.authority: User delegated pose selection and source-art organization in this task.
checks: Compared face, materials and silhouette against canonical source.
Reviewed front/side/rear orientation and compact standing anatomy.
Checked row baselines and corresponding head sizes using manual landmarks.
corrections: Reversed incorrect standing rear tail to screen left.
limits: Use the canonical front and reviewed turnaround together; the superseded combined side/back source has been removed.
Side views retain the approved oblique presentation; do not treat them as calibrated 90-degree orthographic projections.

identity_constraints: Pearl-white cat, triangular ears with lavender interiors, black oval eyes, three black whisker bars per cheek, pink cheeks and a small w-shaped mouth.
Large head, compact body and short rounded limbs.
Thick white tail starts at rear pelvis and curls to anatomical left: screen right in front view, screen left in rear view.

pose_selection.locomotion: Use standing reference to expose limb attachments; add action-specific key poses before generating a cycle.

animation_contract.default_prop_policy: Wheel is a seated pose prop, not equipped clothing. Empty-handed standing is an additional anatomy reference, not an app appearance replacement.
animation_contract.scale: Choose one anatomical scale from the canonical head width. Reuse it for a whole clip; never fit each frame independently to its nontransparent bounds.
animation_contract.anchors: Keep a fixed root and ground plane; represent jumping and travel as intentional root offsets. Preserve crop offsets when exporting trimmed frames.

review_tolerances.status: initial review thresholds, not anatomical truth

animation_contract.rendering: Use one renderer-specific transform per clip/pose, not per-frame auto-centering. Do not impose identical whole-body heights on seated and standing poses.
animation_contract.validation: Review actual-size playback, contact points, loop seam and transitions into/out of seated idle; static references alone do not validate motion.
